R013/r1 remains unchanged.

## Decision
Use one Node.js 22 local process with a command-line entry. The validator owns no persistent state.

## System boundary and responsibilities
The input adapter reads one local manifest, the validator produces findings, and the output adapter writes one local findings file.

The manifest stays owned by the operator. The in-memory normalized record is passed from adapter to validator; the findings record is passed to the output adapter. No data is retained.

The command-line entry with frozen fixture manifest-v1 is the primary behavioral seam. Invalid input returns non-zero, writes no findings file, and leaves input unchanged; the operator can correct the file and retry.

No credentials, network, external service, production side effect, or retained data.

Remote use, history, service deployment, and a database remain out of scope until a committed Release needs them.
